title: CANONICAL_RELEASE_METADATA (single source of truth for release DECLARATION)
comment: REL-001: Git-tracked metadata NEVER records its own commit hash or the final asset SHA (both unknowable before commit). Declaration = version/tag/asset_name/repository. Resolution = installer/validator run `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}` at runtime; asset SHA comes from the Release manifest / GitHub Release, computed AFTER the asset exists.

history.v1.6.0_defect: tag-internal metadata recorded a stale self-referential release_commit (8be9502) and PENDING_UNTIL_RELEASE asset_sha256; superseded by v1.6.1 Declaration/Resolution model
